{{Quote|How do we know you're really Canderous?''"<br />"''Well, Edric, I could punch you in the face until I straightened out that crooked beak of yours, but we'd probably all freeze to death before I finished.''"<br />''"It's good to see you again, brother!|Edric and [[Canderous Ordo]], reunited on [[Rekkiad]]|<ref name="Revan" />}}
'''Edric Ordo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], and a member of [[Clan Ordo]]. A close friend of clan mate and cousin [[Canderous Ordo]], following the end of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Clan Ordo's [[Chief/Legends|leader]], [[Tegris Ordo]], Edric and Canderous were separated as Clan Ordo became scattered. Though Canderous set out on his own as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], Edric kept to what remained of his clan. Following Clan Ordo's newest leader, [[Veela Ordo]], Edric took part in the Mandalorian clans' [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|search]] for the lost [[Mandalore's Mask|mask of Mandalore]], taken by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] when he [[Battle of Malachor V|defeated]] [[Mandalore the Ultimate]]. The search led to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]], where Edric was reunited with his old friend Canderous, who was also searching for [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore's]] Mask with the help of an undercover Revan. Soon after, Revan led Clan Ordo to where he had hidden Mandalore's Mask, allowing Canderous to claim it and become Mandalore the Preserver.

==Biography==
{{Quote|If you're scared, I'll get Edric to take your place and you can watch over the camp.''"<br />"''The old man would probably have a heart attack halfway up.''"<br />"''He's only a year older than you.|[[Veela Ordo|Veela]] and Canderous Ordo|<ref name="Revan" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Edric Ordo was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] from the [[Clan Ordo|Ordo clan]]. A [[Standard year/Legends|year]] older than his clan mate and cousin, [[Canderous Ordo]], Edric and Canderous became longtime friends. However, their close ties were severed following the end of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Clan Ordo]]'s [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]], [[Tegris Ordo]], and the two drifted apart as Clan Ordo grew divided and scattered.<ref name="Revan" />

By the year [[3954 BBY]], Edric had joined a more cohesive gathering of Clan Ordo as part of the Mandalorians' [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|search]] for the lost [[Mandalore's Mask|mask of Mandalore]]. The [[Armor/Legends|armored]] helmet had been taken by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] following his [[Battle of Malachor V|defeat]] of the Mandalorian leader, [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], at [[Malachor V]]<ref name="Revan" /> [[3960 BBY|six years earlier]],<ref name="CotOR">{{LucasArts|url=games/swkotor_sithlords|text=''Chronicles of the Old Republic''|int=Chronicles of the Old Republic}}</ref> and hidden by Revan so that the Mandalorians would be unable to choose a new [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]]. Edric and the clans searched [[Planet/Legends|world]] after world along the estimated trajectory of Revan's departure from Malachor V, until finally they came to the planet [[Rekkiad]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Edric and Clan Ordo established a base camp on the [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered world and, led by clan chief [[Veela Ordo]], began to search their surrounding territory for the mask. Acting as a sentry for the encampment, Edric was reunited with his old friend Canderous when the former Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] arrived on Rekkiad with an undercover Revan to seek the Mandalore's Mask. He warmly greeted Canderous, and rushed both Canderous and Revan into a large supply building to get the two out of Rekkiad's cold weather. Inside, Edric joined several other Mandalorians in welcoming Canderous back to his clan until the arrival of Veela Ordo, Canderous' estranged [[Marriage/Legends|wife]]. When she angrily accused Canderous of abandoning both her and his clan, it was Edric who came to his friend's defense by proposing ''cin vhetin'', a Mandalorian tradition of forgiving an individual's past and offering them a clean slate; Veela agreed, and Canderous was allowed to remain with Clan Ordo. That night, Edric and numerous other members of the Ordo clan [[Alcohol/Legends|drank]] and celebrated the return of Canderous.<ref name="Revan" />

The early hours of the following morning, Canderous and Revan spoke before a gathering of clan members, Edric among them, asking that Clan Ordo's camp be moved. Edric was resistant to talk of a relocation, stating that their current site was shielded from both the weather and any potential attack, though he relented when Revan explained that he knew where Mandalore's Mask had been hidden. Careful not to expose his true identity to the Mandalorians, Revan described the mask's location from a fragmented memory, which Edric recognized as the [[Twin Spears]] mountain. Satisfied that the potential benefits of finding the mask outweighed the hastle of moving the camp, Veela agreed to relocate. Once the encampment had been deconstructed and packed away for transit, Edric led a team of six [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] ahead of the clan to search for the best path; at nightfall, it was Edric's team who discovered a small ice valley suitable for Clan Ordo to spend the night. That evening, Edric again made an effort to catch up with Canderous, and include his old friend in the clan's festivities.<ref name="Revan" />

Having moved into the territory occupied by the rival [[Clan Jendri]], Clan Ordo came [[Skirmish on Rekkiad|under attack]] early the next morning, but managed to repel the assault with the help of Revan and their six [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]]. When the Ordo clan reached the base of the Twin Spears, Edric was left in charge of watching over the camp while Veela led a team comprised of Canderous, Revan, the Basilisk [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Grizzer (Mandalorian)|Grizzer]], and four others up to the summit of the mountain. There, they found Mandalore's Mask, but Veela had determined Revan's identity during the earlier battle with Clan Jendri and turned on him, ordering her clan mates to [[Skirmish in Dramath the Second's tomb|attack]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Canderous defended his friend against the other Mandalorians' betrayal, and in the resulting [[Lightfight|firefight]], Veela and the others were killed. Canderous claimed the mask of Mandalore, taking the title of Mandalore the Preserver, before returning to Edric and the rest of Clan Ordo.<ref name="Revan" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Don't judge Veela too harshly. She's a good leader, but she has a temper. You should remember that the next time you provoke her.|Edric Ordo|<ref name="Revan" />}}
Edric Ordo was a loyal and understanding friend, forgiving of a [[Sentience/Legends|being's]] mistakes and supportive of their strengths. He believed in the Mandalorian concept of ''cin vhetin'', the idea of allowing an individual to have a fresh start. An able scout and a competent tactician, Edric knew how to utilize the terrain to the benefit of himself and his clan.<ref name="Revan" />

Edric enjoyed the Mandalorian [[Ale/Legends|ale]] known as [[Kri'gee/Legends|''kri'gee'']], despite its potency and bitter taste. He could speak the [[Language/Legends|languages]] of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']].<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Edric Ordo first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2011]] novel, ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Drew Karpyshyn]].
